# Claims

1. A helmet comprising:
   a shell;
   a rear light array mounted on a rear portion of the shell;
   a wireless receiver configured to receive a turn signal from a handlebar remote; and
   a controller configured to flash a left segment or a right segment of the rear light array in response to the turn signal.

2. The helmet of claim 1, wherein the rear light array comprises light-emitting diodes.

3. A method of signaling a turn, the method comprising:
   receiving, by a controller in a helmet, a signal from a handlebar remote;
   determining whether the signal is a left signal or a right signal; and
   flashing a corresponding segment of a rear light array of the helmet.
